_description: After every Write or Edit to agents/<name>.md (excluding agents/.deprecated/*), sync the agent to the Notion Agents database via /notion:publish agent <name>. Keeps the Agents database in sync with the repo without manual publish calls. Silent no-op for any other file path.
_notes: $CLAUDE_HOOK_DIR resolves to $HOME/.claude/hooks for user scope, .claude/hooks for project scope.
Matches only agents/<name>.md at the top level — agents/.deprecated/* is excluded (firing a file should not republish it as Active).
Owned by the agent-lifecycle meta-agent. Failures log to ~/.claude/notion-sync.log and never block the Write/Edit.
First-time gotcha: the hook fires on every save, including mid-edit drafts. Combine with debouncing or only-on-commit if mid-edit publishes are noisy.
